p: Disk Usage Trend + Linear Regression Forecast
s:
WITH historical AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('1 day', bucket) AS time,
    device_id,
    AVG(avg_disk_used) AS value,
    'History' AS metric
  FROM public.sys_hourly
  WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket)
    AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND avg_disk_used >= 0
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
regression AS (
  SELECT
    device_id,
    COALESCE(regr_slope(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS slope,
    COALESCE(regr_intercept(avg_used, day_num), 0::double precision) AS intercept
  FROM (
    SELECT device_id,
      AVG(avg_disk_used) AS avg_used,
      extract(epoch FROM time_bucket('1 day', bucket)) / 86400 AS day_num
    FROM public.sys_hourly
    WHERE bucket > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
      AND device_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    GROUP BY device_id, time_bucket('1 day', bucket)
  ) d
  GROUP BY device_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 7
),
future_points AS (
  SELECT
    gs AS time,
    r.device_id,
    'Forecast' AS metric,
    GREATEST(0, ROUND(
      (r.slope * (extract(epoch FROM gs) / 86400) + r.intercept)::numeric, 2
    )) AS value
  FROM regression r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    (SELECT MAX(time) FROM historical) + INTERVAL '1 day',
    (SELECT MAX(time) FROM historical) + INTERVAL '30 days',
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) gs
  WHERE r.slope > 0
)
SELECT bucket AS time, device_id, value, metric FROM historical
UNION ALL
SELECT bucket AS time, device_id, value, metric FROM future_points
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT 'THERMAL (81501)' AS "Alarm Category", ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_temp_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS "Correlation %", COUNT(*) AS "Event Count" FROM v_ldi_alarm_context WHERE errorcode = '81501'
UNION ALL

UNION ALL

p: Alarm Context (±5 min of clicked timestamp)
s:
WITH target AS (SELECT "time" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1),
selected_machine AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0 THEN split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1)
             ELSE ${machine_id:sqlstring} END AS eqp_id
), alarm_rows AS (
SELECT al.logdate AS "Time",al.equipmentid AS "Machine",al.errorcode::TEXT AS "errorcode",al.errortime::TEXT AS "errortime",
 COALESCE(m.alarm_msg,al.errorcode::TEXT) AS "Message",COALESCE(m.alarm_type,'UNMAPPED') AS "Severity"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON al.errorcode::TEXT=m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE al.equipmentid=sm.eqp_id
 AND al.logdate BETWEEN (SELECT "time"-INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target) AND (SELECT "time"+INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
)
SELECT "Time", "Machine", "errorcode", "errortime", "Message", "Severity" FROM alarm_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT target."time",sm.eqp_id,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,'No alarm in +/-5 minutes (real data)','NONE'
FROM target CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm_rows)
ORDER BY "Time" DESC;

p: Event Timeline around Selected Log ID (+/-5 min)
s:
WITH target AS (SELECT "time" AS t FROM public.ldi_data WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1), events AS (
  SELECT d."time" AS event_time,d.eqp_id,'STATE'::TEXT AS event_type,'ldi_data'::TEXT AS source,
         CASE WHEN d.state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'DOWN' END AS description
  FROM public.ldi_data d,target
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0 AND d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)) OR (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))) AND d."time" BETWEEN target.t-INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t+INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.logdate,a.equipmentid,'ALARM','ldi_alarm_log',COALESCE(m.alarm_msg,a.errorcode::TEXT)
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT=m.alarm_code::TEXT,target
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC > 0 AND a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)) OR (${event_time_ms:raw}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))) AND a.logdate BETWEEN target.t-INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t+INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
SELECT event_time AS "Event Time",eqp_id AS "Machine",event_type AS "Event Type",source AS "Source",description AS "Description"
FROM events ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(avg_cpu)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(cpu_load_percent)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Peak Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(avg_cpu)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Peak Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(cpu_load_percent)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(max_temp)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND max_temp > 0 GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(temp_c)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND temp_c > 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Hottest Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(max_temp)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND max_temp > 0 GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Hottest Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(temp_c)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AND temp_c > 0 GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(avg_ram_used / NULLIF(avg_ram_total, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Fleet Average' AS metric, ROUND(AVG(ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

SELECT bucket AS time, 'Worst Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(avg_ram_used / NULLIF(avg_ram_total, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT bucket AS time, 'Worst Machine' AS metric, ROUND(MAX(ram_used_mb / NULLIF(ram_total_mb, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC,1) AS value FROM public.sys_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND time > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(bucket) FROM public.sys_hourly), NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') GROUP BY time ORDER BY 1

-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
WITH alarm_counts AS (
  SELECT equipmentid AS eqp_id, COUNT(*) AS alarm_rows, MAX(logdate) AS last_alarm
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
  GROUP BY equipmentid
)
SELECT
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  MIN(d.factory) AS "Factory",
  MIN(d.process) AS "Process",
  COUNT(*) AS "Telemetry Rows",
  MAX(d."time") AS "Latest Telemetry",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.pe_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "PE %",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_1) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "JE1-3 %",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(d.je_4) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "JE4 %",
  COALESCE(MAX(a.alarm_rows), 0) AS "Alarm Rows",
  MAX(a.last_alarm) AS "Latest Alarm"
FROM public.ldi_data d
LEFT JOIN alarm_counts a ON a.eqp_id = d.eqp_id
WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY d.eqp_id
ORDER BY d.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
WITH telemetry AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
), alarms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid AS eqp_id FROM public.ldi_alarm_log
), ids AS (
  SELECT eqp_id FROM telemetry
  UNION
  SELECT eqp_id FROM alarms
)
SELECT
  i.eqp_id AS "Machine ID",
  (t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL) AS "In Telemetry",
  (a.eqp_id IS NOT NULL) AS "In Alarm",
  CASE
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NOT NULL AND a.eqp_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'MATCHED'
    WHEN t.eqp_id IS NULL THEN 'ALARM ONLY'
    ELSE 'TELEMETRY ONLY'
  END AS "Mapping Status"
FROM ids i
LEFT JOIN telemetry t USING (eqp_id)
LEFT JOIN alarms a USING (eqp_id)
ORDER BY "Mapping Status", i.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;

-- Intentional full table scan for global readiness
SELECT
  d.eqp_id AS "Machine",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.pe_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "PE1-6",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_1) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE1-3",
  CASE WHEN COUNT(d.je_4) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO DATA' END AS "JE4",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.air_vacuum) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.air_vacuum) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    WHEN BOOL_AND(d.air_vacuum = 0) THEN 'ALL ZERO - VERIFY'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Vacuum",
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d.scan_speed) > 1 THEN 'VARIABLE SIGNAL'
    WHEN COUNT(d.scan_speed) = 0 THEN 'NO DATA'
    ELSE 'CONSTANT - VERIFY'
  END AS "Scan Speed",
  CASE WHEN MAX(a.eqp_id) IS NOT NULL THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'NO MATCHING ID' END AS "Alarm Source"
FROM public.ldi_data d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT equipmentid AS eqp_id FROM public.ldi_alarm_log) a ON a.eqp_id = d.eqp_id
WHERE d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
GROUP BY d.eqp_id
ORDER BY d.eqp_id
LIMIT 1000;
